choices.A: The line is parallel to the plane
choices.B: The line and the plane have only one point of intersection
choices.C: The line is perpendicular to the plane
choices.D: The entire line lies in this plane

question: If two points on a line lie in a plane, what follows?
solution: Under the usual reading that “two points” means two distinct points, apply the basic line-plane incidence fact: if two distinct points of a line lie in a plane, the entire line lies in that plane. Therefore the answer is D.
